title: Driver Vehicle Inspection Exception Report
subtitle: Driver Vehicle Inspection: preserves facts, evidence, and actions.
description: Driver Vehicle Inspection Exception Report covers power unit, trailer, safety equipment, visible defect, driver report, and release status. The fleet dispatch coordinator records Driver Vehicle Inspection chronology, evidence, containment, and effectiveness. Driver Vehicle Inspection Exception Report keeps Driver Vehicle Inspection exceptions visible until the fleet dispatch coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use Driver Vehicle Inspection Exception Report at yard, roadside safe area, vehicle cab, exterior walkaround, and trailer. Document power unit, trailer, safety equipment, visible defect, driver report, and release status identity before Driver Vehicle Inspection begins. Compare power unit, trailer, safety equipment, visible defect, driver report, and release status findings with stated Driver Vehicle Inspection criteria; route unresolved Driver Vehicle Inspection issues to qualified vehicle maintenance reviewer. For Driver Vehicle Inspection Exception Report, confirm requirements for Driver Vehicle Inspection. Ask qualified vehicle maintenance reviewer to review Driver Vehicle Inspection conditions beyond the fleet dispatch coordinator's role.

sections.guidance: Record when the issue was discovered, who reported it, the exact affected subject, and the initial condition.

sections.title: Affected scope, evidence, and escalation
sections.guidance: Preserve volatile evidence, distinguish affected from unaffected scope, and keep required notifications visible.

blocks.label: Do not proceed without control
blocks.guidance: Stop normal processing when a safety-critical defect, inspection limitation, repair verification, or qualified release remains unresolved. Protect power unit, trailer, safety equipment, visible defect, driver report, and release status; document the Driver Vehicle Inspection notification and await qualified vehicle maintenance reviewer direction.

blocks.label: Evidence preserved or linked
blocks.guidance: Attach or link proof for power unit, trailer, safety equipment, visible defect, driver report, and release status; mark only Driver Vehicle Inspection evidence present in that record.

blocks.label: Driver Vehicle Inspection investigation points
items: Tires, wheels, fasteners, and visible inflation
Lights, reflectors, mirrors, glazing, and wipers
Brakes, steering, suspension, coupling, and visible leaks
Horn, warning devices, emergency equipment, and restraints
Load securement, doors, landing gear, and trailer condition
Defect classification, restriction, repair, and release
blocks.guidance: Record what was checked without converting an allegation, inference, or unavailable fact into an observation.

blocks.label: Severity, notification, and escalation triggers
blocks.guidance: For Driver Vehicle Inspection, identify affected power unit, trailer, safety equipment, visible defect, driver report, and release status scope; ask fleet dispatch coordinator to document the Driver Vehicle Inspection immediate control before continuing.

sections.title: Corrective action, disposition, and review
sections.guidance: Track containment through disposition and an effectiveness check; do not close an incident merely because the immediate event stopped.
